commits.subject: d1109-onerepo-link: a plan-only plan card promises no documents, the Changes row names the project made, the take-over's Undo refusal reads as one sentence; Add to it through the UI client against the real daemon (U-091, U-087)

fixed.problem: Review blocking 1: a plan-only plan card promised a docs pull request that is never opened. This was Add to it's card and every plan of a project worked on together. The card read "About CHF 0.31 for the 5 tasks; the docs go to the project's repository as a pull request." but its approval writes no document (design section 5 rule 9). Sibling found while fixing it: Approve and start's working line said "Writing the plan and its docs pull request…" on every card of a repository, plan-only ones included.
fixed.failing_test_before: apps/ui/test/onerepo-link.test.tsx 'd1109-onerepo-link, run C: a plan-only plan promises no documents; the take-over's Undo refusal on Changes (review)': 'a plan-only card says its total and nothing about documents ...' and 'Add to it on a project with tasks: Atlas's plan card in the Inbox lists the new work and says nothing about documents'. packages/runtime/test/intake.test.ts OR-08 case 'the first plan of a project without tasks is the new-project form; ...' failed with "expected 'repository' to be null" on the base. apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'd1109-onerepo-link, run C' > 'Add to it through the UI client ...' failed on the 202's docsTarget and on the working line ('Writing the plan and its docs pull request…').
fixed.how:
Root cause: intake.ts filed docs_target "repository" beside plan_only, and InboxPage added the docs clause from docs_target alone.
- packages/runtime/src/session/intake.ts: a plan-only card files plan_only and no docs_target. propose (new and reused) answers docsTarget null.
- api-types.ts: IntakeProposalView.docsTarget is now nullable.
- apps/ui/src/pages/InboxPage.tsx: IntakeCardView.planOnly reads card.plan_only. The total line goes through the new exported intakeTotalLine(card, totalWords), which adds the docs clause only to a first plan to a repository.
- packages/runtime/src/daemon/request-words.ts: the working line is 'Writing the plan…' when card.plan_only is true.
fixed.check_in_the_app:
Bench (done, steps f01-f08): New project 'Site' on bench/seeded with a brief. Its first plan card's total still ends '; the docs go to the project's repository as a pull request.'. Approve it. Then New project 'Shop' on https://github.com/bench/seeded.git with a brief > Add to it > Inbox: Site's card reads 'About CHF 0.43 for the 5 tasks.' with nothing about docs. Approve and start opens no fr/intake-*-docs, fr/docs-scaffold or fr/status pull request.
Work together on a repository whose marker names 'Kite club': its first plan card's total names no documents either.
Live check 4 (real model): Add to it on a project with tasks. Read the plan card's total line, and the line shown while Approve and start works ('Writing the plan…'). Confirm the card lists only new work. The stand-in re-plans the existing titles, so only the real model shows whether the 'Already in the project' block is followed.

fixed.problem: Review blocking 2: after Work together, the Changes row named a project that does not exist: 'Created the project Kites and made it the active project.' on the 'Kite club' row. 'Kites' was the typed name; the project was made under the marker's name.
fixed.failing_test_before: packages/commands/test/onerepo-link.test.ts 'd1109-onerepo-link, run C: project.create's sentence names the project that was made (review)' failed with "expected 'Created the project Kites and made it…' to be 'Created the project Kite club and mad…'". apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts OR-15 case 'Work together adopts the repository's project id ...' failed with "expected 'Created the project My kites and made…'". It now asserts the full sentence, also for the row Work together brings back after Undo and a restart.
fixed.how:
Root cause: project.create's run built its sentence from params.name, not from the row the creation port made (the marker's name, or a removed together row's own name).
- packages/commands/src/commands/project.ts: the new createdOutcomeWords names project.name.
- A name other than the one asked for came from the repository. In that case the outcome carries the untrusted mark (repo_file, repository:<link>), so the chat model gets the sentence as data.
- The Undo then names no other project. In-process it uses the card's words; after a restart it uses 'Undone: <the row's sentence>'.
fixed.check_in_the_app:
Bench (done, step f09): put a marker naming 'Kite club' on bench/empty's main. New project 'Kites' on bench/empty > Work together > Changes: the Kite club row reads 'Created the project Kite club and made it the active project.' with Undo, and no row says 'Kites'.
Live check 4 (LC-C1, two homes on the sandbox repository): after Work together on home B, Changes names the repository's project name. Undo, then Work together again: the new row names the same project.

fixed.problem: Review blocking 3: the take-over's Undo refusal read badly on Changes: 'Cannot be undone now: Its pull request on GitHub already names this project: close it there first..' (double period, capital after the colon, two colons).
fixed.failing_test_before: apps/ui/test/onerepo-link.test.tsx 'the take-over's Undo refusal reads as one sentence on Changes, for each of its three reasons' (the UI test with the real reason constants). apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts OR-07 case failed with "expected 'Its pull request on GitHub already na…' to be 'its pull request on GitHub already na…'". That case now also asserts the Changes sentence built from GET /changes' undoBlockedReason, for the open and the merged pull request.
fixed.how:
Root cause: TAKE_OVER_UNDO_OPEN, _MERGED and _UNREADABLE were full capitalised sentences. Every other command's undoBlocked reason is a fragment that the screens complete ('Cannot be undone now: ….' on Changes, 'Not undone: ….' after a refused press, 'Refused: …' for chat).
- packages/runtime/src/sources/repository-words.ts now words them as fragments, following the precedent 'a session of X is running. Stop it first'.
- Changes now reads 'Cannot be undone now: its pull request on GitHub already names this project. Close it there first.', 'Cannot be undone now: the repository already names this project on GitHub.' and 'Cannot be undone now: GitHub did not answer, so the repository cannot be checked. Try again.'
- The fake daemon has state.takeOverUndoBlocked to drive repo.take_over's Undo.
- Assertions updated: packages/commands/test/repo-take-over.test.ts, real-daemon OR-07. The intent is unchanged.
fixed.check_in_the_app:
Bench (done, steps f10-f14): project 'Later' on a repository whose main later gets another Forerunner's marker. Overview > Take it over > Changes reads 'Cannot be undone now: its pull request on GitHub already names this project. Close it there first.'. The same after restart-daemon.mjs. Undo is offered once that pull request is closed on GitHub.
Live check 4: the same on the sandbox. After merging the docs pull request, Changes reads 'Cannot be undone now: the repository already names this project on GitHub.'

fixed.problem: Review blocking 4 (validation rule 3): POST /projects/:id/intake was changed by this area and called by the dialog's Add to it through client.proposeIntake, but had no real-daemon case. The fake had drifted from the daemon: its card options were ['Approve', ...], the card had no proposal, its docsTarget was 'workspace', and its 409 details lacked requestId.
fixed.failing_test_before: apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts 'd1109-onerepo-link, run C' > 'Add to it through the UI client on a project with tasks: 202 with no docs target; ... (OR-08)'. It is new and failed on the base sources: "expected { pending: true, …(7) } to match object { …docsTarget: null }", then on the working line. apps/ui/test/onerepo-link.test.tsx 'Add to it on a project with tasks ...' failed against the old fake: no intake-card.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Not visible on its own: it is the boundary test of the Add to it path. In the app it is the f02-f05 bench steps above. Live check 4: Add to it on a project with tasks, and time the wait while 'Adding…' shows (it stays synchronous; see not_done).

not_done.why: On the area spec's cut line, as the fixer reported. The new real-daemon case covers the synchronous answer; only the real model shows how long the wait is (live check 4).

They are unchanged here, as are the read-back words: chat has no together flag, so its read-back always names the name asked for. After a restart the Undo reads 'Undone: Created the project Kite club and made it the active project.' from the corrected row.

tests_changed_for_design.test: packages/commands/test/repo-take-over.test.ts (the port's blocked reason) and apps/ui/test/real-daemon.test.ts OR-07 case ('Undo is refused while its docs pull request is open and once it merged')
tests_changed_for_design.why: The take-over's Undo reasons are now fragments the screens complete, as every command's are: 'its pull request on GitHub already names this project. Close it there first' and 'the repository already names this project on GitHub'. The intent is kept, and the OR-07 case now also asserts the full Changes sentence.

It found the creation row by startsWith('Created the project'). It now asserts the whole sentence, 'Created the project Kite club and made it the active project. Undo.', and the same for the row Work together brings back. This is a stronger assertion, not a design change.

new_problems: The stand-in re-plans the same titles for Add to it because it does not read the 'Already in the project' block. On the bench, Site had its 5 first-plan tasks and the same 5 titles again after the approval. Only the real model shows whether the plan-only instruction is followed (live check 4).
notes_for_other_areas: IntakeProposalView.docsTarget is now nullable: null for the plan-only form. A plan-only card (change_card.plan_only true) has no docs_target. The UI reads IntakeCardView.planOnly and words the plan card's total through the exported intakeTotalLine(card, totalWords) in apps/ui/src/pages/InboxPage.tsx.

request-words.ts: Approve and start's working line is 'Writing the plan…' for a plan_only card, even on a repository. 'Writing the plan and its docs pull request…' is kept for a first plan to a repository.

project.create's run sentence names the project the creation port made (createdOutcomeWords in packages/commands/src/commands/project.ts). When that name differs from the one asked for, the outcome carries untrusted {source 'repo_file', origin 'repository:<link>'}.

For the session lead's U-091 entry and the user guide: an Add to it plan card's total reads 'About CHF 0.43 for the 5 tasks.' (no docs clause); after Work together, Changes reads 'Created the project Kite club and made it the active project.'; the take-over's Undo on Changes reads 'Cannot be undone now: its pull request on GitHub already names this project. Close it there first.' or, once merged, 'Cannot be undone now: the repository already names this project on GitHub.'

C2 merge step: this fix-up does not touch the chat's tool list or the project_create and repo_take_over definitions. server.ts is unchanged; intake.ts changes only the plan-only card's docs_target and propose's docsTarget, in d1109-onerepo-link's own hunks.
